label: light zone, germinal center
resolved_names: germinal center light zone T follicular helper cell
evidence: Azimuth human_tonsil_v2 fine label 'light zone, germinal center' (order 438) denotes a T follicular helper (Tfh) cell positioned in the germinal center light zone. Literature consistently defines GC-Tfh as CXCR5-high, PD-1-high, BCL6+ CD4 T cells that reside in the light zone and deliver selection help to centrocytes. ASTA holds only the atlas abstract (CorpusId 238530091); biology resolved via broader snippet_search.
